summary: @servicetitan/ko-bridge preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated opaque payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, marks it executable, and immediately invokes it against a bundled math_init.js file. setup.mjs is heavily obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (hex-prefixed identifiers, per-function string/opcode dispatcher objects) that conceals the fetch-and-execute flow. The executed math_init.js is a ~730 KB Bun-compiled bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') with an obfuscator.io string-array rotation routine (WV8StW) and a ~1000-entry mixed literal array; it contains no readable strings and has no correspondence with the package's src/ tree. The package is advertised as a Knockout/React UI bridge library, a purpose that does not require pulling an alternate JavaScript runtime or executing an opaque compiled bundle at install time. The chain — obfuscated preinstall wrapper, alternate-runtime dropper (Bun), and opaque payload executed under a non-Node interpreter — bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-resolvable code and delivers unreviewable code execution on the installer's host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
